title: One set of controls: Italy
kaylee: The three "I'm done" buttons in Italy (the mask shop, her own pizza's toppings, the pizza cutter) now show the game's own drawn tick instead of the iPad's emoji, like the other countries.

pictures.title: Her own pizza: done
pictures.caption: Same mint button, same corner; the green emoji box becomes the drawn tick. The cutter's done button is the same change.
